subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a merit of the parliamentary system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmony between legislature and executive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Unity of Action:** The parliamentary system ensures a close relationship and cooperation between the executive and the legislature, ensuring unity of action and purpose in governance.
 
• **Responsibility:** The parliamentary system makes the executive (government) accountable to the legislature and, through it, to the people, thus ensuring a responsible government.
 
• **Flexibility:** It provides flexibility in the government's functioning, as the executive can be changed without a general election if it loses the confidence of the legislature.
 
• **Representation:** The system often ensures broader representation of diverse groups and opinions in the legislature, promoting inclusive governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parliamentary System:**

 
 
• A system of government where the executive derives its democratic legitimacy from, and is accountable to, the legislature; the executive and legislative branches are thus interconnected.
 
• Examples include the United Kingdom, India, Canada, Australia, and Japan.
 
• The head of state may be a different person from the head of government, e.g., the President and the Prime Minister in India.
 
• In a parliamentary system, the Prime Minister is usually the head of government, while the head of state may be a monarch or a president.
 
 
 
• **Autocracy:**
 
 
• A system of government in which a single person possesses unlimited power.
 
• Examples include absolute monarchies and dictatorships.
 
• Autocracies are characterized by the centralization of power and lack of political pluralism.
 
 
 
• **Narrow Representation:**
 
 
• A situation where only a limited group of people or interests are represented in the government.
 
• This can lead to exclusion and lack of representation for minority groups or differing opinions.
 
 
 
• **Non-responsible Government:**
 
 
• A system where the executive is not directly accountable to the legislature or the electorate.
 
• Such systems can lead to a lack of checks and balances and reduced accountability of the executive.
